reviews.author: Manasa
reviews.text:
My experience at this clinic was disappointing. After using the products recommended to me, my skin condition became noticeably worse. I experienced more acne on my forehead and cheeks, increased skin darkening, enlarged pores, and more comedones than before.

I also felt that my concerns were not properly addressed, and expensive products were recommended without enough consideration of whether they would suit my skin type. Unfortunately, I did not see any improvement and was unhappy with the overall experience.
